_comment: Canonical per-language phrase(s) a policy document uses to mark a section as deliberately empty (e.g. renumbered out, reserved, or removed by a later revision). Matching in scripts/ingestion/extract_policy_sections.py is casefold- and accent-insensitive and ignores surrounding punctuation/whitespace, so one canonical spelling per language covers every capitalization actually seen in a document ('Intentionally Deleted.', 'INTENTIONALLY DELETED'). To support another market's document, add its language code here with the exact phrase that market's policy uses for this marker (e.g. "es": ["Eliminado Intencionalmente"], "fr": ["Supprime Intentionnellement"]) - no code change is needed.
